changeSet.sql:
-- List Names table: holds categories of lookup lists CREATE TABLE list_names ( id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, created_on TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_on TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT list_names_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uk_list_names_name UNIQUE (name) );
-- List Values table: holds actual lookup values linked to list names CREATE TABLE list_values ( id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), value VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, list_name_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, created_on TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_on TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT list_values_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT fk_list_values_list_name FOREIGN KEY (list_name_id) REFERENCES list_names(id) ); CREATE INDEX idx_list_values_list_name_id ON list_values (list_name_id);
